comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 flags a concrete personal anecdote: the commenter recounts a specific experience of their own or of someone they know. Feature 1 flags third-person analytical framing: the argument is carried by they/he/it/society-style discussion rather than by addressing the OP directly. A comment can be a first-person anecdote without being third-person analysis, and the reverse also holds. The eligibility rules also differ. Feature 0 excludes hypotheticals, statistics and general claims. Feature 1 is a stylistic or addressee test with no anecdote requirement.
